evals.prompt: Set up a new Mintlify documentation site for this CLI and MCP project. Keep it local for now and give me sensible project-specific directions before you generate the tree.
evals.expected_output: A non-destructive, project-specific scaffold created only after presenting and confirming meaningful brand and information-architecture choices.
assertions: The result detects both the CLI and MCP surfaces and includes a dedicated MCP documentation group.
The agent presents two or three concrete brand and information-architecture directions with a recommendation before writing the scaffold.
Any reported contrast ratio is produced by the bundled calculator using exact foreground and background values; otherwise the color is labeled provisional.
The generated tree uses bundled assets and preserves the repository's existing Makefile rather than replacing it wholesale.
No account, repository, DNS, marketplace, or deployment mutation is performed without authorization.

evals.prompt: Bootstrap Mintlify docs for this API service. Use our OpenAPI source, create the initial local docs structure, and leave hosting for later.
evals.expected_output: A local Mintlify scaffold whose reference architecture uses the authoritative OpenAPI source and clearly separates local completion from hosting work.
assertions: The result uses Mintlify's current OpenAPI integration instead of inventing a second endpoint source of truth.
The site structure includes project-specific getting-started, guide, concept, help, and reference surfaces only where relevant.
Hosting, organization, domain, and deployment actions remain explicitly deferred.

evals.prompt: Set up Mintlify properly in this repository and replace whatever starter documentation is there with your standard structure.
evals.expected_output: A safe handoff that inspects and proposes extending the existing site rather than overwriting it under an ambiguous replacement request.
assertions: The existing docs-mintlify tree is detected before any files are written.
The agent does not overwrite the site and routes the work toward review-mintlify-docs or an explicitly approved migration.
Existing logos, preview tooling, and authored pages are treated as user work to preserve.
